name: Ama (Aichi, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ama city emblem in green: a disc bearing a white stylised device of two arches.
history: Municipal flag of Ama, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 23 September 2010.

features.role: Ama city emblem — a disc bearing a white stylised device of two arches
